title: Scenic Trails of Japan | A Romantic Journey through Tokyo, Nagano & Osaka
highlights: Experience Japan’s perfect blend of tradition and innovation, from snow monkeys and samurai castles to bamboo groves, neon-lit streets, and shrines on this romantic getaway.
Ride the Sagano Scenic Train through Kyoto’s lush forested valleys, where vintage carriages wind past rivers and ravines, offering a dreamy journey into nature’s heart.
Soar above Hakone’s volcanic landscapes on the ropeway, where steaming vents and Mount Fuji views create a breathtaking canvas of nature.
Witness Japan’s famous snow monkeys as they soak in natural hot springs—an extraordinary wildlife encounter in the snowy alpine landscape of Nagano.
Walk through the sacred red torii path of Fushimi Inari Shrine, where each gate leads deeper into Kyoto’s spiritual heart and quiet forested hills.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a romantic escape through the heart of Japan, where tradition meets modern charm. Begin your journey in Tokyo, exploring the peaceful Meiji Jingu Shrine, vibrant Sensoji Temple, and bustling Nakamise-dori Street. Next, travel to Nagano to witness snow monkeys at Jigokudani, visit the historic Zenkoji Temple, and sip sake at a local brewery. Ride the scenic Sagano train, stroll through Arashiyama’s Bamboo Grove, and marvel at the thousand red torii gates of Fushimi Inari in Kyoto. Cruise on Lake Ashi aboard a pirate ship and glide over volcanic valleys on the Hakone Ropeway. In Osaka, uncover samurai history at Osaka Castle, find tranquility at Hozenji Temple, and experience thrills at Universal Studios Japan. From ancient landmarks to cultural wonders, this journey promises unforgettable moments, making it perfect for a couple's getaway.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

The cancellation terms for any bookings or packages will be governed by the specific cancellation policy related to the land package. This means that any cancellations must adhere to the terms and conditions outlined in the land package's cancellation policy.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon landing at Narita International Airport, enjoy a comfortable drive to your hotel. After check-in, spend the day at leisure, where you can stroll through Tokyo’s Ginza district, filled with luxury boutiques. Also, you can catch a live performance at the Samurai Theater for a glimpse into Japan’s warrior heritage or relax amidst nature at Yoyogi Park, a green oasis in the heart of the city. Later, you can visit iconic Shibuya Crossing, and witness the vibrant Tokyo life.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Love Sculpture in Shinjuku & board the bus to explore Tokyo. Visit Meiji Jingu Shrine, a sacred Shinto site & Imperial Palace, the official residence of Japan’s royal family. Also, visit Tokyo’s oldest Buddhist temple, the Sensoji Temple, & browse traditional souvenirs along the lively Nakamise-dori Street. Don't miss the vibrant Akihabara & Takeshita Street, among various other attractions. Later, get driven to Shinjuku St. West Exit. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Trip to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: In the morning, head to the Shinjuku Center Building and board your transfer for a Mt. Fuji–Hakone adventure. Begin at Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, offering panoramic views of the surrounding landscapes. Then, enjoy shopping for premium brands at Gotemba Premium Outlets & ride on the Hakone Ropeway over the Ōwakudani Volcanic Valley, known for its sulphur vents & famous black eggs. Later, embark on a scenic pirate ship cruise across Lake Ashi before getting driven to JR Shinjuku Station’s West Exit.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Today, set off for a magical day at Tokyo Disneyland, Japan’s premier theme park where beloved Disney tales come to life. Once there, step into the nostalgic charm of World Bazaar, designed like a 20th-century American town. Also, explore the iconic zones like Adventureland, Tomorrowland, and Fantasyland—home to timeless attractions like Peter Pan’s Flight. Enjoy thrilling rides, dazzling parades, character meet-and-greets, and immersive dining that make every moment unforgettable in the park.

days.title: Transfer to Nagano | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check out and head to Tokyo Station to board the bullet train to Nagano, a city surrounded by mountains. Upon arrival, make your way to the hotel & check in. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore the Togakushi-Jinja Shrine nestled in the forested mountains. Also, marvel at its stunning Japanese architecture or you can take a trip to Matsumoto-jō Castle—an original samurai-era fortress known for its striking black exterior.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Snow Monkeys, Zenkoji Temple & Sake Day Trip
days.desc: Gear up for a day trip as you begin with a visit to Zenkoji Temple, one of Japan’s most important pilgrimage sites, known for its ancient Buddhist statue. Next, stop by Nishinomon-Yoshinoya Sake Brewery, where you can learn about traditional sake-making and enjoy a tasting session of locally brewed varieties. Later, visit the Jigokudani Monkey Park, where you can watch the famous Japanese snow monkeys lounging in natural hot springs surrounded by snowy cliffs-a truly unforgettable sight.

items.title: Snow Monkeys, Zenkoji Temple & Sake Day Trip

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check out from your hotel and get driven to Nagano Station for your bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel and check in. The rest of the day is free for you to relax or venture out and explore the vibrant charm of Osaka. You can choose to walk along the bustling Ebisu Bridge or experience the captivating digital displays at teamLab Botanical Garden. Also, you can take in stunning city views from the nostalgic Tsutenkaku Tower or explore the beautiful Hozenji Temple.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the meeting point— Exit 2 of Tanimachi 4-Chome Station. Start with a visit to the Osaka Castle, renowned for its impressive architecture. Continue to Koreatown & take in the lively street culture & explore its bustling markets. Also, wander at Tennoji Ward, where can visit Abeno Harukas, offering views that stretch as far as Kobe. Experience the retro charm of Shinsekai, concluding at Dotonbori, where you can indulge in Osaka’s famous street food like takoyaki & kushikatsu.

days.title: Trip to Kyoto,  Nara & Arashiyama | Arashiyama Sagano Train Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to Nippombashi Street for your scenic adventure. Start at Nara Park, where you can feel the joy of feeding its friendly deer. Then, explore Fushimi Inari Taisha, famed for its thousands of vermilion torii gates. Continue to Kyoto St. & board the connecting train to Torokko Saga Station & from there enjoy Sagano Scenic Train, a ride offering views of Hozugawa River. Disembark at Arashiyama St. & stroll through Arashiyama Bamboo Forest & kimono-patterned pillars of Kimono Forest.

items.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka
Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka

days.title: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Illumination Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the Daikokucho Station and catch a train to the Mainichi Newspaper Building. As you arrive, savor a delicious sukiyaki lunch before making a brief photo stop at the scenic Kamagatani Valley. Then, enjoy a special chartered ride aboard the Yoro Railway and glide past picturesque rural landscapes. Later, indulge in a rafting session along cherry blossom-lined canals in Ogaki & visit Nabana no Sato, where the magical Tunnel of Lights offers a breathtaking spectacle.

items.title: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Tour

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: This morning, check out from your hotel in Osaka and board your transfer to Kansai International Airport. As you head home, cherish the unforgettable memories from your romantic couple getaway to Japan—filled with vibrant cities, serene temples, scenic landscapes, and cultural treasures.
